# `prefer-optional-pop`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports a non-empty check used only to guard a discarded `ArrayList.pop()`
result.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

In current Zig, `pop()` already returns `null` for an empty array list, so the
representation-level length check repeats the operation's contract.

## When it fires

The receiver must resolve to an explicitly typed standard array list, the result
must be discarded, and the guard must have no other effect. A surrounding `and`
condition is preserved. The rewrite is eligible for fix-all.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn drop(values: *std.ArrayList(u8)) void {
    if (values.items.len != 0) _ = values.pop();
}
```
